// Overlaid into original controllers. In-memory HTTP recorders, disposable
// synthetic store only; no listening server, network or external auth is used.
package usagehistory

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"github.com/seakee/cpa-manager-plus/apps/manager-server/internal/app"
	"github.com/seakee/cpa-manager-plus/apps/manager-server/internal/config"
	"github.com/seakee/cpa-manager-plus/apps/manager-server/internal/service/adminauth"
	history "github.com/seakee/cpa-manager-plus/apps/manager-server/internal/service/usagehistory"
	"github.com/seakee/cpa-manager-plus/apps/manager-server/internal/store"
	"github.com/seakee/cpa-manager-plus/apps/manager-server/internal/testutil"
)

func TestPacerHistoricalExportOracle(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("PACER_ORACLE_OUT")
	raw, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(out, "historical-oracle.json"))
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	var cases []struct {
		Name, View, Window, Kind string
		Filter                   history.ProfileFilter
		Quota                    *history.QuotaUsageFilter
	}
	if e = json.Unmarshal(raw, &cases); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	st, e := store.Open(filepath.Join(out, "oracle.sqlite"))
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	defer st.Close()
	testutil.EnsureAdminCredential(t, st)
	s := history.New(st, nil)
	if e = s.Init(context.Background()); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	h := Handler{App: &app.Context{UsageHistoryService: s, AdminAuthService: adminauth.New(config.Config{}, st)}}
	outputs := map[string]string{}
	for _, item := range cases {
		if item.View == "forecasts" {
			continue
		}
		var filter any = item.Filter
		if item.Quota != nil {
			filter = item.Quota
		}
		raw, _ := json.Marshal(filter)
		var fields map[string]any
		d := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
		d.UseNumber()
		if e = d.Decode(&fields); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		q := url.Values{}
		for k, v := range fields {
			q.Set(k, fmt.Sprint(v))
		}
		if item.Window != "" {
			q.Set("window", item.Window)
		}
		if item.Kind != "" {
			q.Set("kind", item.Kind)
		}
		for _, format := range []string{"json", "csv"} {
			q.Set("format", format)
			w := httptest.NewRecorder()
			request := httptest.NewRequest("GET", "/synthetic?"+q.Encode(), nil)
			request.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+testutil.AdminKey)
			switch item.View {
			case "profiles", "profile-proof":
				h.Profiles(w, request)
			case "history", "history-proof":
				h.Handle(w, request)
			case "quota":
				h.quotaUsage(w, request)
			default:
				t.Fatal(item.View)
			}
			if w.Code != 200 {
				t.Fatalf("%s/%s %d %s", item.View, item.Name, w.Code, w.Body.String())
			}
			outputs[item.View+"/"+item.Name+"/"+format] = w.Body.String()
		}
	}
	raw, e = json.MarshalIndent(outputs, "", "  ")
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if e = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, "historical-exports.json"), append(raw, '\n'), 0600); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	t.Logf("%d original controller export responses", len(outputs))
}
